spans.s:
चौर mf. (-रः-री)
 1. A thief, a robber, a pilferer.
 2. A plant: see चोरपुष्पी
3. A perfume.
 f. (-री) Stealing, theft.
 E. चोर a thief, affix अण्.

चौरतस् ind. From theft.
 E. चौर, and तसि for the sign of the fifth case.

चौरहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Stolen, robbed.
 E. चौर, and हृत taken.

चौरापहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Carried off, stolen.
 E. चौर and अपहृत taken
away.

चौरिका f. (-का) Theft, robbing.
 E. चोर a thief, वुञ् affix, optionally
चोरिका; or चौरी theft, कन् added.

चौर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Theft, robbing.
 E. चोर a thief, ष्यञ aff.

चौर्य्यार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Acquired by plunder or robbery.
 E. चौर्य्य,
and अर्ज्जित gained.
